purpose: Prevent reconstructed/reflowed digital editions from entering spatial training while preparing exact image-bound measurements for TC001 是 and 和.

sourceClasses.A: museum/original-object image preserving the historical writing field and line arrangement
sourceClasses.B: institutional facsimile preserving the original 28-line geometry
sourceClasses.C: scholarly reproduction whose geometry can be registered against A/B
sourceClasses.D: reflowed, font-substituted, redrawn, decorative, or otherwise reconstructed edition

admission.rule: No image may supply bounding boxes, line gaps, lean, scale, or line-axis measurements until its geometry is shown to preserve the original writing field.

knownNegativeControl.reason: The site explicitly states that it reflows the original 28 irregular lines into 27 lines of 12 characters. It is useful for text/order checking only and must never supply spatial evidence.

是.sequence: 暢敘幽情｜是日也｜天朗氣清

和.sequence: 天朗氣清｜惠風和暢｜仰觀宇宙

registrationContract.step1: Register the full historical writing field before any line or glyph crop.
registrationContract.step2: Represent the writing field in normalized coordinates x,y,w,h within [0,1].
registrationContract.step3: Segment all 28 historical lines/columns and retain their irregular lengths; do not regularize spacing.
registrationContract.step4: Bind each line to transcription by sequence, not by assumed fixed character count.
registrationContract.step5: Locate the complete lines containing 是日也 and 惠風和暢 and preserve those line crops as parent evidence.
registrationContract.step6: Only then derive glyph bounding boxes for 是 and 和 relative to both parent line and full writing field.
registrationContract.step7: Record neighboring gaps, relative scale, center of gravity, lean, line-axis offset, entry/exit direction and visible/implicit continuation.
registrationContract.step8: Cross-check structure against 秘閣帖 and 定武 witnesses without importing their spacing or brush-pressure properties.

currentStatus.reasonForHold: No authoritative pixel representation preserving the original 28-line geometry has yet been registered in the corpus. Coordinates must not be guessed from text or from a reflowed digital recreation.

nextGate.name: shenlong-first-image-bound-cells
nextGate.requirement: Register an A/B source image preserving the original geometry, segment its historical lines, then attach measured bounding boxes and parent-line evidence to 是 and 和.
